description: FULL BODY: A Malaysian male in his late 30s, athletic build, wearing a crisp dark blue Polis Diraja Malaysia (PDRM) uniform with silver buttons and insignia on the shoulders. He has short, neat black hair and a clean-shaven face. He wears black polished leather boots and a tactical belt.
FULL BODY: A Malaysian Chinese man in his late 60s, slender build with silver-grey hair and spectacles. He is wearing a simple light-colored polo shirt, dark trousers, and comfortable sneakers.

FULL BODY: An anonymous human figure appearing as a featureless pitch-black silhouette. The figure has glowing red digital circuit patterns tracing across its chest and limbs, giving it a robotic AI-glitch aesthetic. The silhouette is wearing a translucent, shadowy hooded cloak.
